title: Jazzy Kenyan Yoghurt Stir fry
description: A briny and creamy Kenyan dish featuring natural yoghurt and stir-fry, cooked to perfection on a comal. This adventurous recipe is raw-friendly and full of flavor.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large comal over medium heat.
Add the sliced red onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chopped kale and cook until it is wilted, stirring occasionally.
In a small bowl, whisk together the natural yoghurt, ground turmeric, ground cumin, salt, and pepper.
Pour the yoghurt mixture over the kale mixture and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the mixture for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the Jazzy Kenyan Yoghurt Stir fry hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
